-- SQL Schema for MedPass Hospital MR Booking System

-- Enable RLS
ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.jwt_secret" TO 'your-secret';

-- 1. Hospitals Table
CREATE TABLE hospitals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  mobile_number TEXT,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  supported_sessions TEXT[] DEFAULT '{MORNING, EVENING, FULL_DAY}',
  pass_limits JSONB DEFAULT '{"MORNING": 10, "EVENING": 10, "FULL_DAY": 5}',
  session_windows JSONB DEFAULT '{"MORNING": {"start": "08:00", "end": "10:00"}, "EVENING": {"start": "16:00", "end": "18:00"}, "FULL_DAY": {"start": "08:00", "end": "18:00"}}',
  auto_lottery_enabled JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  auto_lottery_times JSONB DEFAULT '{}'
);

-- 2. Pharma Companies Table
CREATE TABLE pharma_companies (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  company_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  contact_number TEXT,
  finance_email TEXT,
  admin_mobile TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  admin_password TEXT NOT NULL,
  contact_email TEXT,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true
);

-- 3. Medical Representatives Table
CREATE TABLE mrs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  mr_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  login_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  mobile_number TEXT,
  password TEXT DEFAULT 'mr123',
  identification_number TEXT,
  slcpi_id TEXT,
  slcpi_photo TEXT,
  slcpi_expiry TEXT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 4. Hospital Users Table
CREATE TABLE hospital_users (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  hospital_id TEXT REFERENCES hospitals(id),
  mobile_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  password TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'ADMIN' | 'SECURITY'
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- 5. Applications Table
CREATE TABLE applications (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  mr_id TEXT REFERENCES mrs(id),
  hospital_id TEXT REFERENCES hospitals(id),
  session TEXT NOT NULL,
  application_date DATE NOT NULL,
  priority_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'applied',
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 6. Passes Table
CREATE TABLE passes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  mr_id TEXT REFERENCES mrs(id),
  hospital_id TEXT REFERENCES hospitals(id),
  session TEXT NOT NULL,
  pass_date DATE NOT NULL,
  time_slot TEXT,
  qr_code TEXT,
  entry_status TEXT DEFAULT 'not_entered'
);

-- 7. Invoices Table
CREATE TABLE invoices (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  company_id TEXT REFERENCES pharma_companies(id),
  amount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  active_mr_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'unpaid',
  date DATE NOT NULL
);

-- 8. Entry Logs Table
CREATE TABLE entry_logs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  issued_pass_id TEXT REFERENCES passes(id),
  entry_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  verified_by TEXT
);

-- 9. Approvals Table
CREATE TABLE approvals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  mr_id TEXT REFERENCES mrs(id),
  hospital_id TEXT REFERENCES hospitals(id),
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Row Level Security (RLS) Policies (Examples)
ALTER TABLE mrs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Public MRs read" ON mrs FOR SELECT USING (true);

ALTER TABLE applications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "MRs can see their own applications" ON applications 
  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid()::text = mr_id);

-- Note: Super Admin logic is usually hardcoded or handled via special roles.

-- MedPass: Hospital MR Pass Booking System - Database Schema

-- Enable UUID extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- 1. Profiles Table (Extends Supabase Auth)
CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('MR', 'HOSPITAL_ADMIN', 'SECURITY', 'COMPANY', 'SUPER_ADMIN')),
  mobile_number TEXT,
  hospital_id UUID, 
  company_id UUID, 
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 2. Hospitals Table
CREATE TABLE public.hospitals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  mobile_number TEXT,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  supported_sessions TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY['MORNING', 'EVENING', 'FULL_DAY'],
  pass_limits JSONB DEFAULT '{"MORNING": 10, "EVENING": 10, "FULL_DAY": 5}',
  session_windows JSONB DEFAULT '{"MORNING": {"start": "08:00", "end": "10:00"}, "EVENING": {"start": "16:00", "end": "18:00"}, "FULL_DAY": {"start": "08:00", "end": "18:00"}}'
);

-- 3. Pharma Companies Table
CREATE TABLE public.pharma_companies (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  company_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  contact_number TEXT,
  finance_email TEXT,
  contact_email TEXT,
  admin_mobile TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  admin_password TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true
);

-- 4. Medical Representatives Table
CREATE TABLE public.mrs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES public.pharma_companies(id),
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  mr_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, 
  login_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  mobile_number TEXT,
  password TEXT DEFAULT 'mr123',
  identification_number TEXT,
  slcpi_id TEXT,
  slcpi_photo TEXT, 
  slcpi_expiry DATE,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 5. Applications Table
CREATE TABLE public.applications (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  mr_id UUID REFERENCES public.mrs(id),
  hospital_id UUID REFERENCES public.hospitals(id),
  session TEXT NOT NULL,
  application_date DATE NOT NULL,
  priority_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'applied' CHECK (status IN ('applied', 'selected', 'waitlisted', 'rejected')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 6. Passes Table
CREATE TABLE public.passes (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  mr_id UUID REFERENCES public.mrs(id),
  hospital_id UUID REFERENCES public.hospitals(id),
  session TEXT NOT NULL,
  pass_date DATE NOT NULL,
  time_slot TEXT,
  qr_code TEXT,
  entry_status TEXT DEFAULT 'not_entered' CHECK (entry_status IN ('not_entered', 'entered', 'expired'))
);

-- 7. Invoices Table
CREATE TABLE public.invoices (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES public.pharma_companies(id),
  amount NUMERIC NOT NULL,
  active_mr_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'unpaid' CHECK (status IN ('paid', 'unpaid')),
  invoice_date DATE NOT NULL
);

-- 8. Entry Logs Table
CREATE TABLE public.entry_logs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  pass_id UUID REFERENCES public.passes(id),
  entry_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  verified_by UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id)
);

-- 9. Approvals Table
CREATE TABLE public.approvals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  mr_id UUID REFERENCES public.mrs(id),
  hospital_id UUID REFERENCES public.hospitals(id),
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS)
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users can see their own profile" ON public.profiles FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);

ALTER TABLE public.hospitals ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Public read for hospitals" ON public.hospitals FOR SELECT USING (true);

ALTER TABLE public.mrs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "MRs see their own record" ON public.mrs FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);

ALTER TABLE public.applications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "MRs see their own apps" ON public.applications FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = mr_id);

ALTER TABLE public.passes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "MRs see their own passes" ON public.passes FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = mr_id);
